Hi Yves,

Thanks a lot! And please accept my apologies for the trouble caused to you and other group members. The posts were displayed as "deleted" and so I thought they were really deleted. I will wait next time. :)

The effect of the Google Group filter seems to be quite specific. Only that post sent to that thread was consistently blocked. I could post a shorter reply to that thread, and I could also send the same long post as a new discussion. Interesting.

-- Shu Fai
